string.text: Other Members Of The Same Clan Settings
Other Clans With No Fiefs Settings
Enable revenue for Player Lords. [Default: true]
Multiplier for player clan revenue. Lower values reduce player income. [Default: 0.30]
Enable towns revenue for AI Lords. [Default: true]
Multiplier for town prosperity income. If set to the default value of 1.00, AI Lords’ income will match the description on the Nexus page. [Default: 1.00]
Enable castles revenue for AI Lords. [Default: true]
Enable villages revenue for AI Lords. [Default: true]
Multiplier for village hearth income. If set to the default value of 1.00, AI Lords’ income will match the description on the Nexus page. [Default: 1.00]
Enable this to consider Lords' trade skill when calculating revenue. For example Trade skill of 75 will increase revenue by 37%. [Default: false]
When this option is enabled all other clan members (not even clan leader) will get revenue. [Default: true]
All other clan members' revenue percentage. Default is 20% of what clan leader gets. [Default: 0.20]
Clans With No Fiefs Gets A Share Of Revenue
Other clans with no fiefs will earn revenue based on the relationship with the kingdom leader and fiefless clan leader. [Default: true]
Fiefless Clans' members revenue percentage when fiefless clan's leader has relation of 0 with the kingdom leader. [Default: 0.05]
Fiefless Clans' members revenue percentage when fiefless clan's leader has relation of 30 with the kingdom leader. [Default: 0.10]
Fiefless Clans' members revenue percentage when fiefless clan's leader has relation of 60 with the kingdom leader. [Default: 0.15]
Fiefless Clans' members revenue percentage when fiefless clan's leader has relation of 100 with the kingdom leader. [Default: 0.20]
How Much More Percentage Clan Leader Will Get

Fiefless Clan leader revenue percentage added after above relationship percentages are calculated. In default setting fiefless clan leader will earn 50% more than other his clan members. [Default: 1.50]
Enable spawning/handling caravans of AI Lords. [Default: false]
Amount of troops caravans will have when created. [Default: 30]
Amount of denars caravans will have when created. [Default: 8520]
Enable trade skill experience for AI lords with caravans. [Default: true]
Base amount of trade experience per caravan that AI lords receive daily. [Default: 15]
Consider Focus Points For Trade XP
When enabled, trade experience from caravans will be affected by focus points and attributes. [Default: false]

Enable arena tournament leaderboard revenue for AI Lords. Every week 12 (by default) most distinguished heroes will get monetary rewards based on their rankings and adjusted number below. [Default: true]
Enable arena tournament leaderboard revenue for Player. [Default: true]
Base reward for arena top leaderboard members. First place gets 2x this amount, 10th place gets 0.5x. [Default: 12460]
Number of arena leaderboard members to reward (from 3 to 30). [Default: 12]

Enable towns denars increase. Towns denars will be increased based on village's hearth. Formula: Vanilla amount (1000 denars) + hearth level (for example 243) = 1243 daily village denars. [Default: true]
Enable automatic building boost for AI lords' settlements. [Default: true]
Multiplier for AI lords' building construction speed. Higher values mean faster building construction. [Default: 1.50]
Denars In Percent AI Clan Lord Will Invest For Buildings Boost
Percentage of AI clan lord's gold they will invest in building boosts (0.0 = none, 100.0 = all gold). [Default: 10.0]
Show logs relevant to the player's kingdom. [Default: false]
Improved Economy income from Kingdom Leader
